notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. New: the interactive SSH terminal gains a two-row extra-keys keyboard (Esc/Ctrl/Alt/Tab/Home/End/PgUp/PgDn/arrows with an Fn toggle to F1–F12/Insert/Delete/symbols), sticky & lock Ctrl/Alt modifiers, auto-repeat on held keys, hardware-keyboard mapping (arrows/F-keys/Ctrl+Alt+letter, Ctrl+Shift+V paste, Ctrl+Shift+C copy), long-press paste and pinch-to-zoom font scaling. Existing tools are untouched: providers + AI router/fallback, local model (Ollama), MCP client, RAG, SSH client/tunnel/TOFU, in-app update, Telegram bot, multimodal Sidekick, Material 3 dynamic color, Eco Mode, Developer Tools, Share & Invite. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
